faqs.question: What is the scope of MBA?
faqs.answer:
The scope of MBA course is increasing day by day. MBA is one of the big job oriented professional programme and the most one which has been sought by the students. Once you have completed your degree, you have a great job opportunity in the industrial world. You may the manager or executive in term of designation.
The management term is most suited to the managers and that's why it is the way, where you can reach on the top of the height as soon as possible by using your leadership and working proficiency. An MBA professional always plays a vital role in his/her company and this is why he used to keep in touch with the board of directors. No need to specify the companies who recruit the MBA professionals. All sectors including government and public have various industries, companies, institutions or related organizations, come in the job prospective fields for an MBA professional.
Some job profiles are listed here:
Brand Manager

International Business Manager

All the best.

reviews_list.batch_info: Certification in Technical Analysis - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Review

review_content.Learning Experience: The module covered technical analysis of trading in depth for an NCFM certification in technical analysis. This was offered through the NSE website platform. It was a self study course followed by a online test at the NSE certified centre which consisted of 100 questions that needed to be completed in 2 hours. The course was pretty comprehensive covering various aspects of technical analysis ranging from Candlestick charts to Trading indicators and risk management. Overall the course was well outlined and ensured good understanding of the subject through easy course content and practical examples. This course is great for individuals who have some prior knowledge of technical analysis. Beginners may find the course little challenging to understand. This course definitely helped me improve my technical analysis skills considerably and helped me in my resume as well when applying for a internship in the stock market.

reviews_list.batch_info: Certification in Technical Analysis - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Review

review_content.Learning Experience: I really enjoyed my learning experience. The course content was engaging and informative. The platform was user-friendly and easy to navigate. The training experience was practical and I was able to apply the skills I learned to my job. The career impact was positive and I was able to advance in my career. The skills I learned were valuable and helped me to become more effective in my job. The challenges I faced were manageable and I was able to overcome them with support from my colleagues. The pros of the course were that it was flexible and allowed me to learn at my own pace. The cons were that it was difficult to balance work and study.

reviews_list.review_title: Decent college, helpful teachers, average placements, and peaceful campus life.

review_content.Placements: Around half of the students got jobs. The highest salary is around 10 LPA- 12 LPA. Most students got about 3 LPA-4 LPA, and the lowest is nearly 2 LPA. Many big companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, and some small startups come to hire. About 30-40 percent of students got internships in TCS, Infosys, and other companies. Most of them are doing jobs like Software Developer or Data Analyst. Some students didn't get a good offer, and not many got a higher package.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our department has many things like Wi-Fi, lab rooms, classrooms, and a library. The labs have computers, but some did not work properly. Classrooms have smart boards, but sometimes they stop working in the middle. The library has many books, but the space is limited and chairs are vintage. The hostel is fine, the rooms are not too big but okay. Sometimes it tastes nice, other times not so good. The canteen is giving snacks and cold drink. Medical help is there, but the doctor is not coming regularly.

reviews_list.batch_info: BCA (Hons.) in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Best college, best faculty.

review_content.Placements: This is a new course, so we don't know about placement and packages. Top recruitment companies are like Amazon, Flipkart, etc. Roles offered are DBA, Data Analyst and much more. Our course is a complete package of artificial intelligence and data science. Best course.
review_content.Infrastructure: Best infrastructure, including labs, classrooms and library, and canteens, food is also good and hygienic, but we don't have a hostel on our campus. Faculty and everything are the best in our college. The campus is in the best location. Wi-Fi works very well. The library is also the best.

Medical help is there, but the doctor is not coming regularly.

paragraphs: Takshashila University admissions begin with registration. Candidates are first required to register for a UG or PG programme. Below are step-wise admission details for Takshashila University:
STEP 1: Takshashila University Application Process 2025
Candidates first need to apply for the programme of their choice. Aspirants need to upload documents and pay application fee to apply for a course.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds

Once the registration is complete, candidates receive a call from the university. Takshashila University selects candidates for any of the UG or PG programme based on merit in the last qualifying exam.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation
Once all the details of the candidates are verified, the admission seat will be allotted to the degree programme. Candidates need to pay the course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

admission_process.title: AIMETC Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: AIMETC also known asApeejay Institute of Management and Engineering Technical Campusoffers various courses inEngineering, Management and Computer Application. Admission to all the courses is merit-based. Further, admission toMBAAIMETCacceptsCMAT and MATscores and forBTechcourses, candidates need to appear forcounselling roundrespectively. Interested candidates are required to apply for admissiononline and offlineby visiting theofficial websiteorvisiting the campus physically. The following segments are all the information related to theApeejay Institute of Management and Engineering Technical Campus admission, course eligibility, and selection criteria.

AIMETC admission 2025is open. The institute carried out anonline and offlinemode of application for all the courses. AIMETC offers various UG and PG courses such asBCom, BBA, MBA, MCAand others. Admission to all the courses ismerit-basedexceptBTech and MBA. For admission to BTech candidates need to appear in thecounselling roundand for MBA, the institute acceptsCMAT and MATfor admission. Check outApeejay Institute of Management and Engineering Technical Campus courseeligibility & selection criteria in the following table:

AIMETC admission process 2025is merit and entrance-based. Further, for BTech, candidates are required to appear for a counselling round. After filling out the eligibility and selection criteria candidates need to apply online and offline for admission. Checkout the following steps for a detailed Apeejay Institute of Management and Engineering Technical Campus admission process 2025:
Step 1: AIMETC Application Process 2025

Candidates seeking admission to any courses at Apeejay Institute of Management and Engineering Technical Campus must submit an application form. To fill out the application form candidates can apply online or by visiting the institute campus.
Step 2: AIMETC Selection Round

As part of the selection process, the candidate must qualify CMAT and MAT exams for admission to MBA. Further, for BTech candidates need to appear in the counselling round. Additionaly, for all other courses institute offers admission based on the last qualifying score.
Step 3: Final Seat Allotment
Apeejay Institute of Management and Engineering Technical Campus releases a merit list of selected candidates for final seat allotment.
Step 4: Admission Confirmation
The candidates who get shortlisted in the selection round must pay course fees within the given dates to lock their seats.

content.Faculty: Facilities and curriculum are good, but exams are too delayed, as well as results. Mostly, results are published one week before the upcoming exam, but no worries at all for the session because they will complete your session on time. They will provide all kinds of notices like examination form, practical, and internal examination.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) (Hons.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Everything is good, but teaching method is not good, which is why students do not attend classes.

content.Placements: Approximately 35% of students got placement in the Bachelor of Commerce program. The highest package is 7 LPA to 8 LPA, the lowest package is about 2-3 LPA, and the average is 3 to 4 LPA. HCL Technology, Flipkart, Myntra, and Genpact are the top recruiting companies. About 40-50% of students got interships at TCS.
content.Infrastructure: There is a library, classrooms, and labs, but our college does not have a canteen. There is no Wi-Fi available. Our college has smart boards, but teachers do not use them. The timing of B.Com classes is very bad, which is one reason students do not attend regularly. A canteen should be provided.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely supportive, the faculty pays more attention to students.
reviews.review_text: I can't really say a lot about hostels as I was staying in a rented apartment, but my friends who stayed in the hostel compliment the living situation of the hostels. The hostels take appropriate procedures regarding who enters and who doesn't inside the hostel, and for what purpose.

reviews.review_heading: Supportive faculty, beautiful campus, good placement.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of university is modern and student-friendly, with Wi-Fi enabled throughout the campus and hostel too. The campus is green and scenic, enhancing the atmosphere for studying and relationships. Hostel provides comfortable accommodation with well-maintained rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it provides good academic years.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good both in the university and hostels. Wi-Fi is available but it does not work. Food is okay. The forensic laboratory in the college needs more instruments. Only two canteen stores are here on the campus. The library has many books and it needs more forensic books.

reviews.review_heading: Its good, it had excellent environment for studying.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure needs improvement. I find the library to be stunning and most of the classrooms as well, but my suggestion would be to modernize the classrooms to properly function as a state of the art institution. The environment of the school was really something that stands out. You can not compare it to anything. I believe its very quiet and very refreshing.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities, such as library and Wi-Fi, are excellent, and classrooms are of a very high standard. The quality of the hostel is that of premium, and food is of average quality for international students. The mescal and sports with games are all available.

reviews.review_heading: The university area is nice but have to improve something.
reviews.review_text: There are no Wi-Fi facilities in our hostel as well as in the college. Classrooms and labs are quite good. Library is also good. The hostel rooms are good but hostel food is not good and hygienic. There are no medical facilities and no pharmacy for students.

reviews.review_heading: APG Shimla University: Hilltop campus, lush greenery, modern buildings, hostels, and sports.
reviews.review_text: Although the campus is not that big it is safe and secure. The ambiance of the university is very quiet and peaceful. Furthermore, the hostel is also safe. You'll get a family here. Rooms are good, big and furnished. Food available in a mess sometimes upsets your stomach but that's able to eat (truth). The infrastructure of the university and hostel is beautiful, especially library. Classrooms are facilitated with projectors, good lighting, and good desks. You can connect yourself with mother na...

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, decent placements, and a great campus life at Shimla University.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are spacious and equipped with projectors and Wi-Fi. The library is well-stocked and useful for business studies, while the computer labs are functional. Hostel facilities are decent, with clean rooms and 24/7 water and electricity. The mess food is average but hygienic. Medical facilities are provided on campus, along with sports and gym facilities for students.

reviews.review_heading: Great University for introverts and if you love nature.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is just average. The labs still have old PCs, and while the Wi-Fi works in the labs, it is limited outside of them. The library is quite good and has plenty of books. Classrooms are fine, and the hostels are decent, equipped with almost all the necessary facilities. The canteen is spacious, but the food quality is inconsistent. There is a gym and sports equipment available for everyone to use.

reviews.review_heading: The overall review of this college is very good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities of the department are quite good compared to other departments, with facilities of free Wi-Fi, labs, and a library. The most attractive thing is the classroom. Through the classroom, you can see the beautiful natural scenery of Shimla, which looks very beautiful. The quality of the facilities in the hostel is good, with free Wi-Fi and hot water in winter. The quality of the food available in the mess and canteen is good, and the fee for the mess is around 4,500 ...

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and weather are good, but faculty and management need improvement.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is really good, and the weather is one of the best here. The hostel is neat and clean, and the quality of food is good. They provide non-veg four times a week. There are three types of rooms: basic, premium, and super premium, with varying prices.

reviews.review_heading: Discipline is very important in this college.
reviews.review_text:
Our university has a hostel which is a shared room. Around our campus, there are many Pgs also. The pgs cost around 6000 rupees per month. It includes the necessary eating things and pockets money. The room of the hostel is quite big for two students to stay. Hostel Fee: INR 100000 per year
External Expenses: Rs.4000 - Rs.7000.

reviews.review_heading: The college is scenic, serene and remote. Culture and exposure are good, but placements are average.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is great. Classrooms, libraries and buildings are good. Facilities are great. A nurse is available here for medical responses. Canteen is great. There are many ethnicities in this college. You will get exposed to many types of people from many countries.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides a peaceful environment to study.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities and infrastructure were provided for students. We had Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms. The library was quite good. The quality of the food served was also very good in the mess and canteen. Medical facilities, Sports and Games were also very good. Everything which was required by the student was available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: The worst university in the world.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility at the university is the worse than a 2G network while most of the systems in labs are useless. Classrooms are average, and only a few classrooms have projectors. There is no playground. The library is worse. As there is no playground, we can't think about the sports facilities for any kind of outdoor games. There is only a volleyball court available. One of the worst things is the food served in the college mess.

review_summary.college_name: Chirayu University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The lifeline of Chirayu's MBBS.

content.Placements: The total students in a year are 250. According to the category, the majority are general. Others are NRI, SC, ST, and OBC category students. The college provides internship in the final year, which is done for one year after you complete your studies, and you are paid as an intern doctor ₹13,000 to ₹14,000 per month.
content.Infrastructure: The structure of the department is well developed. There are multiple departments in the college building along with a library and study area. The library has free Wi-Fi and multiple facilities. In the hostel, the facilities are also waiting, and there is an open ground for the students to play games.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Excellent infrastructure, greenery, campus life, time tables followed, no extreme ragging.

content.Placements: CMCH Bhopal offers an excellent learning environment with hands-on practical training in the hospital which leads to good placement of graduates. Also, the work-study balance during internship is good making more selection in NEET PG. I have seen my seniors securing seats in most demanding branches.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure and equipment are almost the latest but hostel food and cleanliness are little concerning. All laboratories are well-managed and equipped. There is a very good practical exposure to all instruments mentioned in books. But for hostel food, there are huge possibilities for improvement. The best part of the entire college is its library.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is a very good college and I am satisfied to get enrolled here.

content.Placements: In our college, there are placements because we are nursing students. They provide only training and hospital duty. We perform practically and improve our knowledge. They teach us all rules and regulations which are used in the medical field. Our college has its hospital and we perform all the practicals and they also teach us how to convey with patients.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college campus is designed very well. Our college is a semi-government college. In our college, B.Sc. nursing and M.Sc nursing courses are available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: CMCH, Bhopal is an awesome college.

content.Placements: Being a student of MBBS, all I can say is to study hard, and your future is assured well. The packages are decent, starting from 4-5 LPA for newbies, and it can increase exponentially to 10-12 LPA or even 30 LPA for super specialities.
content.Infrastructure: Food quality is above average. The hostel is like my second home, with interactive personalities around. The campus has a cafe and all sports activities for soothing you. The library is resourceful, and the study room is available 24*7 as all you expect from a med school.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall, our college is the best medical college in Madhya Pradesh.

content.Placements: At least 72%-75% of the students got placed from our college. The salary package offered in MBBS course depends on the government authorities. The lowest salary offered ranges from Rs. 70,000 to 1 lac per month. It depends on the choice of students in which companies they want to join. At least 30% to 40% of the students got internships from our college. Postgraduate graduate degrees like MD and MS are offered here.
content.Infrastructure: In the MBBS course, there are 19 subjects, and different subjects have a separate department and their own labs and libraries. Labs are well defined, and there are air-conditioned classrooms. There are separate boys and girls hostels, and the quality of the food served is good. The canteen also has varieties of food items. Chirayu Medical College is India's first medical college where elections are held between students for many posts like sports secretary-general, secretary, treasury president and vice president.

faqs.question: Does Acharyapuram Agri Business Management School, Greater Noida offer any fellowship programme?
faqs.answer: Yes, Acharyapuram Agri Business Management School offers an 11-month long online programme with two mandatory visits to the main Campus of 5 days each. A grant of INR 72,000 will be given to students attending 3rd semester of MSc. There are 20 (50% reserved for girls) seats available for the programme. Candidates are not required to pay any programme fee.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at Acharyapuram Agri Business Management School?

Candidates are admitted only based on scores of various entrance exams conducted at national-level for Management courses. reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Clinical Research and Healthcare Management - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Life at Jaipur National University

review_content.Placements: Out of 11 students, 6 got pre-placement from companies with an average package of 5 LPA. The highest package was 6.5 LPA, and the lowest package was 3 LPA. Only Indian-based companies visited the college to provide placement; no MNC was visiting the college for pre-placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms were well maintained. Only fans are there. No AC was installed in the classrooms. In the library, AC is there. Library and playgrounds are well maintained, and students can access them at any point in time. The canteen area is also there for lunch. The bank is also located on campus.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Clinical Research and Healthcare Management - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Average college; the placement percentage was quite low, but the teachers are well qualified.

review_content.Placements: In our batch, there are a total of 21 students, and for pre-placement, 2 companies came to hire. Both companies required only 2 students each, so out of 21, only 4 got placed through the college; the rest found placements on their own. The college provided unpaid internships to all the students. Considering this, the placement rate was too low at 20%.
review_content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are quite good, with acceptable seating chairs. However, in our classroom, there are only fans; there are no AC or ducting facilities in summer, which was quite disappointing. The college canteen is normal, providing all the necessary items for breakfast, but for proper lunch, you have to go outside. The playgrounds are in good condition.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Clinical Research and Healthcare Management - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: College is great for studies, but not for fun activities.

review_content.Placements: Few companies come for placements, but some are not related to the field and only 1 or 2 students get jobs. They can't provide any internships; we have to do it on our own. Seminars by many companies are organized to motivate students. If you are brilliant in your studies, you definitely get placement.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, and the labs and all facilities are also good, but the rules and regulations are strict. Libraries are available in all three campuses: SADTM, SIILAS, and the main campus. SIILAS is as small as a school.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Clinical Research and Healthcare Management - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Best college of Jaipur for every course. Knowledge hub .

review_content.Placements: Upto 70 to 75% students were placed in B.Sc. course The highest package offered in this course is almost 3 to 3.5 Lacs and the lowest is 2 Lacs. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Cipla, etc. Almost 50 to 53% of students got internships from this course in these companies .
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good. The campus is beautiful. Lots of facilities are provided by the campus. Nice Wi-Fi with 5G speed. Digital classrooms make courses easy to understand. Discipline is the best of best quality in hostel and the food quality was awesome.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Clinical Research and Healthcare Management - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: College experience worth it.

review_content.Placements: The placement faculty is unexpectedly preferable here. I was doing a B.Sc. course and it had almost 800 to 900 students. This session, the highest package offered is around 60 LPA-80 LPA, the lowest is around 10 LPA, and the average is 15 LPA with internship experience and a skilled resume.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are good. Almost everything needed was provided like good speed Wi-Fi, a library for focused studies, etc. Almost no power cuts and always have backup, hygienic mess, and good food along with a responsible warden.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Clinical Research and Healthcare Management - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Reality of jnu, everything about faculty, infrastructure placement, hostel Life.

review_content.Placements: There is no chance to get placement. U have to word hard for getting job. Don't rely on college as they only make fool. Toppers of college, gold medalist is not getting placement from this college. So who else will supposed to get that job. Work on your niche as no placement or job u will get from this college. They only make fools and during admission false statement are passed. That number of students gets placed in this company etc. But in reality no placement are provided.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is quite good. Labs classroom all are quite impressive. But Wi-Fi is not working at all neither in college nor in hostel. Hostel is dam strict that u have to make pass if u want to go market or any other place. Wardens are strict and are ready to put their noise in your personal life. Mess food is quite good and regular checking by faculty. Only one thing that I like about this college is hostel mess as they listen to your demands that if u r ill they will make daliya or thing that u want to eat.

placement_data.title: ICRI - Jaipur National University, Jaipur Placement overview
paragraphs: ICRI Jaipur boasts of 100% placements offered to its students in various streams such as Clinical Research, Healthcare and Pharmacovigilance . ICRI placements of all the eight campuses are conducted centrally by the authorities of Institute of Clinical Research of India.

The institute offers students with plenty of employment opportunities and career prospects. It offers ample amount of industry exposure to enhance the students' employability. It has an impressive placement record and offers high ROI.

The institute conducts placement sessions and recruitment drives at the end of every year. Over the years, numerous ICRI students have secured high-paying jobs in clinical research, healthcare, logistics, retail, air freight, manufacturing, cargo freight, pharma, banking, automobile and aviation industries.
Various companies are invited to ICRI campus by the active placement cell. Here is the step-by-step process of placements at ICRI:
Q. How are the placements at ICRI? What is their recruitment process?
A. ICRI has a 100% placement record. Placements are conducted through campus recruitment process. The recruiting companies for campus placements follow the standard selection procedure.
Q. What is the placement process of ICRI Jaipur?

A. The college has an active placement cell which handles all the placement related tasks. Various companies are invited to the pre-placement talk on the assigned date. Test/ Group Discussion is conducted by the company followed by a personal interview of the shortlisted students. Results are declared within 2-3 days from the interview.
Q. Who are the major recruiters of ICRI?
Q. Does ICRI offer internships to its students?

A. Yes, companies offer internship /industrial training to its students. Industrial Visits / Seminars / Conferences / Guest Lectures are also conducted by the institute to give students insights about the various activities involved in the industries.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Computer Science - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Infrastructure and teachers are good.

content.Placements: Our college placements are not good as students want. Approximately 30% of the students got placed from college in any company for their job. Top recruiting companies come when they need good students or employees. The highest salary package offered is 5 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 1 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, and it is well-maintained for student education. It has a water cooler, bathroom, auditorium, well-designed classrooms, Wi-Fi, library, labs and canteen. The college is in the city, which is the main benefit for students. You can find all books in the library.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Its good for those who just wants a degree.

content.Placements: My college is a decent college it's only for those students who wants to get a degree or pursue their graduation. The placement are not very good here around 5%-10% students are placed in my college which is not a good thing it's very good for those who only wants to get a degree.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure it's not too big but classrooms are quiet good projectors are placed in every classrooms there is proper labs available for all subjects but there's a bad thing no hostel mess and canteen are available in my college so it's all about infrastructure.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college in Indore.

content.Placements: Almost 45% of students got placed in our course. The highest salary package offered was 12 LPA. The lowest salary package offered was 5 LPA. The top roles offered are manager, investment manager, CA, accountant, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is good in this college. Wi-Fi is enabled. Classrooms are well-maintained. It also provides a laboratory. The library is very good. Security facility is also provided on our campus.

Some good companies visited for electronics and computer branches. 40-45% of students got placed. 6.5 LPA was the highest salary package, 2 LPA was the average salary package, and 1.5 LPA was the lowest salary package offered. The companies that came to college were L&T, CMS IT, Tata etc. The college is very supportive. Internships are mandatory for all students in the final year. Students got internships from NATS portal.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is excellent compared to other colleges. The natural beauty of college is good in winter and rainy seasons. There is a big statue of Shivaji Maharaj near the college. There are various courses like EXTC, automobile, computer, IT, and mechanical. The college provides good facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library etc. The library is updated. Various reference books are available in the library. Classrooms and labs are awesome. The college provides other facilities like hostel, mess, canteen, medical, ambulance, sports, games, gym, and security. There are 2 girls' hostels, 1 staff hostel, and a building for our principal, available. The hostels are comfortable, safe and clean. There are beds, geyser, toilets, bathroom and all other facilities. Various food items are available in the mess and canteen. It is tasty but sometimes not. 2 ambulances are available for emergency cases. There are indoor and outdoor games available.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the college. It provides a good education.

content.Placements: About 40% of the students from our course got placed. The highest salary package offered was 7 LPA, and the average salary package offered was 2.5 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 1.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies like CMS IT and L&T visit our campus for placements. Top roles, like network admin, tech support, analyst, etc., are offered to the students. The highest salary package offered in our course was 4 LPA, and the average salary package offered was 2.5 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 2 LPA. About 10-20% of the students got an internship through NATS portal.

content.Placements: Moderate placement activities are conducted in our college. Students underwent average placement training which was required to crack the placement test at the time only. TCS was the one of top MNCs visited for placements which offers higher salary packages for students.
content.Faculty: Not all lecturers were good at teaching, but few of them were known for their excellence in teaching. During teaching, they reduce and add the content according to their convenience. reviews.review_heading: NPR College of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: Moderate placement activities are conducted in our college. Students underwent average placement training which was required to crack the placement test at the time only. TCS was the one of top MNCs visited for placements which offers higher salary packages for students.

reviews.review_heading: Now it is a autonomous institution. Satisfied with the faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members are well-versed in their knowledge. I am studying in the 2023 batch with autonomous accreditation. The infrastructure is very good, with a lot of green plants and trees, and the campus is surrounded by mountains. Hostel food is average. The labs are well-equipped. A cricket ground is available on campus. TNPL events are conducted here once a year. Badminton, volleyball, and basketball courts are also available.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was excellent. Classrooms were well-maintained. Laboratory was excellent. There was a decent library in this college. Hostel facilities were good. The food served in the mess was decent. Playground was good. Transportation facilities were very good .

reviews.review_heading: 100 percent students were placed in my course, the previous year.
reviews.review_text: Separate classrooms with lights and fans for every year is provides. Separate laboratories for the subjects are provided, and the quality of the computers is good. Separate library for my department is available. Hostel is good and the food in hostel is good and hygienic. Cricket is the famous sport in my college.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the coaching and also gets all the students placed.
reviews.review_text: The faculties are very friendly and they teach well and clear all the doubts. Our College has Wi-Fi facilities, library, digital library, separate labs for separate departments, and smart classes. There are separate hostels for boys and girls. The food is good and they also provide a feast one day per month.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is excellent.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Our campus is surrounded by trees. Hostels are better. It also has a turf ground. Canteen is available. Mess is excellent.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with faculty members and extracurricular activities, but not with placement.
reviews.review_text: Facilities were absolutely good and Wi-Fi service is available all over the area of the college. Labs facilities are so good and lots of equipment are very useful to students to understand their knowledge. In classrooms, more than 60 students are present and each classroom projector is available. The library was good and very helpful.

reviews.review_heading: Well disciplines college.
reviews.review_text: I've never been to my college hostel but friends from the hostel tell me that it is very comfortable to be there and the food quality is really good. Medical facilities and a separate Gym for boys and girls are available. Large cricket fields, basketball courts, and football courts are available.

reviews.review_heading: I would recommend joining this college.
reviews.review_text: In this college, there is a very good natural structure is available. A national-level cricket stadium is also there. TNPL is also conducted. Students can watch it freely when matches are conducted. But it is not a good city like that the surroundings look like a village.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent college with good environment and classroom experience. World class infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: We had 24hrs Wi-Fi through our campus. Labs facilities where too good they provide system to all students. Good classroom environment. In library we get all books we need. Good place to develop sport's. They provide good hostel facilities. Good food where provided to students with non veg and veg foods. 24hrs ambulance facilities and first aid where given to student at any time. Our college have world class cricket ground. More often Indian and national cricketers' visits our college.

reviews.review_heading: I am very proud of our college.
reviews.review_text: Our college management provides us with great infrastructure like 100 Mbps speed Wi-Fi facility, labs with facilitated equipment with good safety measures, classrooms and libraries with a safe environment. Our college has a good hostel and healthy food facility.

reviews.review_heading: The location of the college is good.
reviews.review_text:
It has the best infractures in south of Tamil Nadu. It is located in Natham near a mountain. There is no Wi-Fi. There are good labs, classrooms and library.
2. The hostel facilities are not that good.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with the faculty. It provided the worst placement for the 2017 batch.
reviews.review_text: The college provides a huge turf cricket ground and a football ground. The college provides separate hostels with mess facilities for both boys and girls. The mess serves both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food for the students. Gym facility is available. A library is available only with a minimal number of foreign author books along with a large number of local author books and books written by faculty members. National or international journals are not available. It demands compulsory transpor...

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is good, and the placements are average.
reviews.review_text: The college has a pleasant and peaceful environment. The infrastructure meets the requirements of the students. It has all the facilities that an engineering college should have. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and its speed is 100mbps. Almost every classroom has a projector and computer facilities. I didn't face any issue with the infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: I will not refer this college. This is like another school with worthless rules.
reviews.review_text: The college has a nice infrastructure, and a cricket ground is available but students can't use it often. The labs are somewhat better when comparing to other colleges. The library staffs are so rude that they won't sign the no dues form if we forget to bring the book we took from the library. Due to improper maintenance of college, we faced insect bites in the first year.
